entries.goal: Keep at least one active human administrator.

runtime.reason: The last human administrator is required for recoverable administration.

entries.goal: Accept additional catalogue media formats.

runtime.reason: The media contract admits a fixed set of validated formats.

entries.goal: Represent product net contents in units other than grams.

runtime.reason: The catalogue read envelope uses grams for net contents.

entries.goal: Use catalogue SKUs that have no GTIN.

runtime.reason: Native catalogue identities require a GTIN.

entries.goal: Find when checkout recovery and abandoned cart reminders are sent.

absentMeans.description: Unpinned checkout recovery episodes use host call parameters, with SQL defaults for omitted offsets. Unpinned abandoned cart episodes use 1, 24 and 72 hours. An existing pin supplies that episode's timing.
absentMeans.source: host call parameters, with SQL defaults for omitted offsets

entries.whyThisDefault: The last checkout wave fits inside the 24-hour checkout window and the cart waves retain the established delivery timing.

effect.appliesTo: A changed schedule supplies timing for new episodes. Follow-up waves of pinned episodes retain the recorded schedule. Older unpinned episodes use live timing.
frozenOn: Enqueued messages and send receipts retain their recorded identity.

runtime.reason: Runtime editing needs episode lineage and delivery replay evidence.

rules.description: The host checkout recovery policy accepts only firstOffsetSeconds, finalOffsetSeconds, checkoutSeconds, recoverySeconds, activitySeconds and profile. Supply seconds as integers from 1 to 2147483647 and keep firstOffsetSeconds below finalOffsetSeconds, which must be below checkoutSeconds after defaults. A supplied profile starts with a lowercase letter and has up to 48 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

entries.goal: Distinguish separate reasons for manually holding an order.

runtime.reason: Native order controls record a fixed manual hold reason.

entries.goal: Serve several markets from one starter configuration.

runtime.reason: A starter configuration has one market and composes its own quote and checkout admission.

entries.goal: Redeem promotion codes in native checkout.

runtime.reason: The native checkout path lacks a promotion-code resolver.

entries.goal: Choose the allowed return reasons.

runtime.reason: The native order service still enforces a fixed vocabulary.

entries.goal: Settle orders and renewal cycles with zero payable.

runtime.reason: Native settlement requires a positive charge amount. Zero-payable fulfillment needs its own settlement path.

entries.goal: Define account consent purposes and copy revisions.

runtime.reason: The native account consent path uses fixed purposes and a fixed copy revision.

entries.goal: Use additional languages for OpenLup communications and identity.

runtime.reason: Package contracts restrict the supported locale vocabulary.

entries.goal: Offer additional delivery methods.

runtime.reason: The delivery contract has a fixed set of native method kinds.

entries.goal: Dispatch independent shipments from one order.

runtime.reason: Native shipment sequencing needs additional fulfillment modeling for this case.

entries.goal: Register a new account through a magic link.

runtime.reason: The native sign-in port admits existing accounts only.

entries.goal: Preserve the original reservation expiry on replay.

runtime.reason: A replay returns the existing hold without changing stock allocation or expiry.

entries.goal: Set safety stock and channel exposure in available-to-promise calculations.

runtime.reason: Native available-to-promise currently uses zero safety stock and no channel allocation.

entries.goal: Set the renewal stock protection horizon used to calculate stock available to new purchases.
entries.whyThisDefault: Two weeks cover a typical replenishment cycle and preserve the established stock priority.

effect.appliesTo: Future available-to-promise calculations and new purchase allocations.
frozenOn: Existing reservations keep their quantities and expiry times.

runtime.reason: Preview estimates availability for named SKUs. Apply changes with the installer at deployment.

rules.description: Supply exactly revision and renewalProtectionDays. Revision must be a nonblank string and renewalProtectionDays an integer from 1 through 3660.

entries.goal: Require the invoice amount and currency to agree with the payment.

runtime.reason: An invoice relies on matching durable payment evidence.

entries.goal: Issue a partial invoice correction.

runtime.reason: The native correction contract supports full reversal.

entries.goal: Set the free shipping threshold in currency minor units.
entries.whyThisDefault: Both samples set the threshold to 1000 minor units.

effect.appliesTo: The starter uses the deployed threshold in estimates. The default quote resolver uses it once the shipping policy takes effect.
frozenOn: The order draft saves the quote's shipping terms when present.

runtime.reason: The starter supplies the threshold through commerceSettingsPort. To keep the threshold with the same quote helper, supply that port in a replacement resolver.

schema.description: assertConfig checks whole minor units from 0 through 2147483647.

entries.goal: Set the subscription discount in basis points.

effect.appliesTo: The starter uses the deployed discount in subscription estimates. Initial installation seeds the native price policy from this value.
frozenOn: The saved checkout quote includes the quoted unit price.

runtime.reason: The starter reads the discount from the owned store config.

schema.description: assertConfig first checks whole basis points from 0 through 10000. Startup and the install seed require a rounded subscription unit price of 1 through 2147483647 minor units. A 10000-basis-point discount produces zero.

entries.goal: Choose the delay and link lifetime for a payment decline notice.

runtime.reason: Native decline notices wait three minutes and issue links for 24 hours.

entries.goal: Authorize a payment now and capture it later.

runtime.reason: The current payment adapter contract has no separate capture operation.

entries.goal: Request a refund through the payment rail.

runtime.reason: The current payment adapter contract has no funds-refund operation.

entries.goal: Register a payment provider capability profile for reconciliation.

runtime.reason: Native recovery uses a fixed set of qualified provider profiles.

entries.goal: Require verified signature, attempt, amount and currency for payment evidence.

runtime.reason: Settlement relies on verified provider evidence tied to the charged attempt.

entries.goal: Quote an offer total that cannot be divided evenly by quantity.

runtime.reason: The offer pricing contract needs an allocation that reconciles each line.

entries.goal: Quote a basket with mixed tax rates.

runtime.reason: The strict quote contract rejects mixed tax rates in one quote.

entries.goal: Apply quantity price breaks in a strict quote.

runtime.reason: The native strict quote selects base prices only.

entries.goal: Keep line totals equal to unit price times quantity in the same currency.

runtime.reason: Financial evidence must reconcile.

entries.goal: Choose a sales channel for strict quotes and price lists.

runtime.reason: The native strict quote and base-price writer currently use one fixed channel.

entries.goal: Select the subscription price rounding rule.

runtime.reason: The current subscription price policy rounds down to the configured quantum.

entries.goal: Choose the subtotal basis for free shipping.

runtime.reason: Native threshold decisions use a fixed basis.

entries.goal: Combine promotion codes using compatibility groups.

runtime.reason: The adjustment engine needs additional combination rules.

entries.goal: Set the checkout reservation lifetime in minutes.

effect.appliesTo: The starter calculates checkout hold expiry from the deployed duration. The recovery runtime uses the configured duration for its expiry calculation.
frozenOn: The reservation row records the expiry assigned at creation.

runtime.reason: The starter reads the duration from the owned store config.

schema.description: assertConfig checks that the duration is a positive safe integer.

entries.goal: Customize validation and normalization of the postal code and phone on saved customer addresses.

absentMeans.description: The platform uses the standard normalization and validation for the supplied address policy.

entries.whyThisDefault: Hosts can choose address formats required by their delivery integrations while preserving existing behavior by default.

frozenOn: Existing saved addresses and captured delivery destinations keep their stored values.

runtime.reason: The callbacks are executable host code.

entries.goal: Support optional postal codes and address regions.

runtime.reason: The native address contract requires a postal code and has no region field.

entries.goal: Save additional payment method preferences.

runtime.reason: The customer preferences contract has a fixed payment method vocabulary.

entries.goal: Find the cancellation age window for subscriber winback messages.
entries.whyThisDefault: The age window preserves the established outreach timing after cancellation. The platform keeps its neutral default of requiring retention consent at the send gate.

frozenOn: Existing winback delivery receipts retain their deduplication identity.

runtime.reason: Discovery documents the age window and send gate. The full policy and episode changes need separate qualification.

change.operation: No settings write operation is available for this key.

entries.goal: Set how many hours before a renewal customers can edit a newly created subscription.
entries.whyThisDefault: The starter sets a 72-hour edit window.

effect.appliesTo: The starter supplies the deployed edit window at native subscription activation.
frozenOn: The activation writes the window on the new subscription row.

runtime.reason: The starter reads the window from the owned store config.

entries.goal: Choose the allowed delivery interval and default cadence for subscriptions.
entries.whyThisDefault: The samples default to 28 days; one also allows 56 days and the other allows 14 and 56 days.

effect.appliesTo: A fresh subscription checkout checks the deployed classic offer. Starter terms admission checks cadence against the offer for the edit's mode.
frozenOn: A saved starter-pack quote records the graduation cadence captured at checkout.

runtime.reason: The starter composes its offers from the owned store config.

schema.description: assertSubscriptionOffer checks days as a nonempty set of distinct integers from 1 through 3660 or a range within those bounds with an integer step from 1 through 2147483647. The default must be in days and in checkoutDays when supplied. assertQuoteConfiguration requires the classic offer to include the graduation cadence.

entries.goal: Reprice renewal shipping from the current address.

runtime.reason: Retained native terms carry one shipping threshold profile.

entries.goal: Renew subscriptions on a fixed calendar day.

runtime.reason: Native cadence is expressed in days.

entries.goal: Offer custom subscription pause durations.

runtime.reason: Native lifecycle commands support two weeks, one month and indefinite.

entries.goal: Require delivery evidence and move alignment only later.

runtime.reason: A late delivery extends the cycle without stacking deliveries. A replacement counts only after arrival.

entries.goal: Schedule introductory discounts by renewal cycle.

runtime.reason: Native terms support one introductory phase before the retained terms take over.

entries.goal: Set the retry budget for dunning and event or reminder dispatch.

effect.appliesTo: On the next scheduled run using this config, the budget limits dunning claims and filters the event and reminder dispatch query. At-risk and operator notices run outside this cap.

runtime.reason: The starter passes its dispatch policy to the lifecycle notice dispatcher.

schema.description: assertSubscriptionCare checks the budget as an integer from 1 through 2147483647.

entries.goal: Prepay several subscription deliveries.

runtime.reason: Native commands refuse multi-cycle prepaid subscriptions.

entries.goal: Change a renewal price without changing the subscription basket.

runtime.reason: Native renewal prices are locked until an edit changes the terms.

entries.goal: Calculate a subscription reschedule date in the market time zone.

runtime.reason: The native command compares dates using UTC days.

entries.goal: Use one retry schedule for host and provider-recorded payment failures.

runtime.reason: Provider-recorded failures still use the fixed 24, 72 and 168 hour schedule.

entries.goal: Use the same delivery controls for managed and native notices.

runtime.reason: Managed and native delivery paths use separate controls.

entries.goal: Set the stock hold lifetime when a renewal leaves stock wait.

runtime.reason: Native stock-wait recovery fixes the hold at 15 minutes in SQL. The separate reservation port reads holdSeconds from its own reserve call, outside native stock-wait recovery. The starter's scheduled renewal uses this port to expire reservations and leaves its holdSeconds option unused.

entries.goal: Set windows for subscriber review requests.

runtime.reason: Review branches exist in SQL and need composition before exposing a setting.

entries.goal: Reconcile unknown payment outcomes before retrying and stop on hard declines.

runtime.reason: Retrying a charge with an unknown outcome risks charging twice.

entries.goal: Send winback again for a new cancellation episode.

runtime.reason: The native winback receipt deduplicates by subscription.
